name: Nord University
summary: University across northern and central Norway; six English bachelor’s: biology and a vet track in Bodø, film, animation, games and acting in Levanger.

handoff.label: How to apply for a bachelor's (international)

ib.text: The IB Diploma, with English, meets the entry requirement. Unless you are Norwegian or live in Norway, you apply through Søknadsweb, where Norwegian is not needed.

dates.label: Application period opens for EU/EEA citizens (yearly date)
Application deadline for EU/EEA citizens (yearly date)
Spring school leavers: educational documents due (yearly date)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Biology
programmes.ib: Any IB maths, plus Maths AA (SL/HL) or AI HL, or an HL science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Design Technology), all at grade 3+.
programmes.about: Physiology, genetics, species diversity, ecology and evolution, with weight on marine and cell biology; lab work, field courses in northern Norway and trips on the research vessel PIA, with a lot of compulsory attendance.

needs.note: Norwegian R1 level; AI SL counts through S1+S2.
A science at Norwegian 1+2 level (HL), or maths at R2 level (AA, or AI HL).

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade points if there are more qualified applicants than places; in 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Animal Science
programmes.ib: Any IB maths plus Chemistry HL, at grade 3 or better.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Free at Nord; fees in Košice
programmes.about: Three semesters of animal biology, chemistry and animal science in Bodø, then three at the veterinary university UVMP in Košice, Slovakia, with a guaranteed place on its veterinary medicine programme afterwards.

needs.note: Norwegian R1 level; AI SL counts through S1+S2.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade points if there are more qualified applicants than places; in 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer.

programmes.name: Film and TV Production
programmes.about: Every stage of film and TV production, from storytelling and directing to camera, sound and editing, with a focus on new media and making good work on small budgets through clever use of technology.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade points if there are more qualified applicants than places; in 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer.

programmes.name: Bachelor in CG Art and Animation
programmes.about: Digital art and animation made with industry-standard tools, in studios also used for filmmaking, game development and interactive media, learning in teams the way a production studio works.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade points if there are more qualified applicants than places; in 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Games and Entertainment Technology
programmes.about: How to make video games and other entertainment and learning products: programming, game design and ludology, traditional art, 3D assets, animation and sound, with project management and gaming ethics.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade points if there are more qualified applicants than places; in 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant got an offer.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Acting and Artistic Production
programmes.ib: Audition in rounds, ending in a four-day workshop in Levanger. 2026 criteria: apply by 15 March; 2027 dates not yet published.
programmes.about: Ensemble-based training in acting, movement, voice, singing and music for theatre, film and other media, with visiting artists and your own productions; a study trip abroad is possible in year three.
programmes.selectionNote: Three audition rounds: self-tapes (an introduction and two monologues), a half-day workshop in Oslo or Levanger, then four days in Levanger. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Samordna opptak warns IB school leavers cannot upload the diploma by 1 July, Nord’s deadline too; ask Nord early how to get your results to them.
Animal Science is a joint degree: three semesters in Bodø, then UVMP in Košice, with a guaranteed place on its veterinary programme.
Biology has a lot of compulsory attendance, including lab work, and Nord expects students to be on campus in Bodø.
